jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Sales
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for driving sales closures across UrbanGaon developments by managing lead follow-up, site visits, channel partner coordination, and customer counselling, while maintaining CRM discipline and ensuring accurate booking documentation and a smooth handoff to collections and customer service.
responsibilities: Follow up on leads promptly and convert inquiries into site visits.
Conduct site visits and property walkthroughs for prospective customers.
Counsel customers on project offerings, pricing, and payment plans.
Coordinate with channel partners (CPs) to generate and manage leads.
Negotiate terms and close sales in line with approved pricing and policies.
Maintain CRM discipline — timely and accurate updates on leads, visits, and status.
Prepare and process booking documentation accurately and on time.
Ensure a smooth handoff of closed bookings to collections and customer service teams.
Build and maintain relationships with channel partners for repeat business.
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets as assigned.
competencies: Strong negotiation and closing skills.
Excellent customer handling and relationship-building ability.
Established channel partner network and coordination skills.
Disciplined CRM usage and process orientation.
Target-driven with a strong sense of ownership.
Good communication and presentation skills.
Resilient, proactive, and self-motivated in a target-based environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Marketing & Branding
jobs.preferredQualification: MBA in Marketing — preferred, not mandatory
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for owning and driving brand campaigns and marketing execution across UrbanGaon developments — including project launch support, digital and social media presence, creative collateral, events, agency coordination, customer communication, and campaign performance tracking — to build strong brand visibility and support sales and business objectives.
responsibilities: Plan and execute brand campaigns across projects, aligned with business and sales objectives.
Support project launches through marketing plans, collateral, and go-to-market coordination.
Manage digital and social media presence, content calendars, and online brand consistency.
Develop and oversee creative collateral — brochures, signage, digital assets, and campaign creatives.
Plan and execute marketing events, activations, and on-ground promotions.
Coordinate with creative, digital, and media agencies to ensure timely, quality delivery.
Manage customer communication and engagement across marketing touchpoints.
Track and report campaign performance, ROI, and marketing effectiveness.
Ensure brand consistency across all marketing materials and channels.
Coordinate with sales and CRM teams to align marketing efforts with lead generation.
competencies: Strong understanding of branding, marketing, and campaign management fundamentals.
Creative sensibility with an eye for design and brand consistency.
Hands-on experience with digital/social media platforms and content planning.
Ability to coordinate multiple agencies and vendors to deliver on time.
Strong project management and multitasking ability across campaigns and launches.
Data-oriented — comfortable tracking and reporting campaign performance and ROI.
Clear communicator, collaborative, and customer-focused.

jobs.title: EA to Director
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for managing the Director's calendar, confidential correspondence, meeting minutes, travel, and communication — including MIS reporting, cross-functional action tracking, document preparation, and priority coordination — to ensure seamless and efficient support to the Director.
responsibilities: Manage the Director's calendar, appointments, and scheduling priorities.
Handle confidential correspondence and follow-ups with discretion.
Prepare accurate meeting minutes and track action items to closure.
Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and itineraries.
Manage internal and external communication on behalf of the Director.
Prepare and maintain MIS reports and dashboards for leadership review.
Track cross-functional actions and follow-ups across departments.
Prepare documents, presentations, and briefing notes for meetings.
Coordinate and prioritize competing demands on the Director's time.
Liaise with internal stakeholders and external contacts for smooth coordination.
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism in handling sensitive matters.
competencies: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
High level of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Excellent minute-taking and documentation skills.
Strong follow-up discipline and ownership of action items.
Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities under pressure.
Professional demeanor with strong organizational and time-management skills.

jobs.title: Head of AI Adoption, IT & Research
jobs.preferredQualification: MBA-Tech hybrid or additional certification in AI/digital transformation — preferred, not mandatory
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for leading practical AI adoption, IT systems, automation, and research intelligence across UrbanGaon, driving digital productivity tools, vendor selection, cybersecurity hygiene, and cross-functional training to enable a technology-forward, data-driven organisation.
responsibilities: Identify and implement practical AI use cases across business functions.
Own and manage IT systems, infrastructure, and digital tools.
Drive automation of manual processes to improve efficiency.
Build data and reporting frameworks to support decision-making.
Lead research intelligence — market, competitor, and technology trends.
Evaluate and roll out digital productivity tools across teams.
Manage vendor selection, evaluation, and contracts for IT/AI solutions.
Ensure cybersecurity hygiene and data protection practices are followed.
Conduct cross-functional training on AI tools and digital adoption.
Partner with leadership and department heads to align technology with business goals.
Monitor and report on AI/IT adoption impact and ROI.
competencies: Strong understanding of AI, IT systems, and digital transformation practices.
Ability to identify practical, high-impact AI use cases for the business.
Strong stakeholder management across leadership and cross-functional teams.
Vendor management and negotiation skills.
Data-driven mindset with strong analytical ability.
Awareness of cybersecurity best practices and data protection.
Strong communication and training/facilitation skills.

jobs.title: Head of Architecture
jobs.mandatoryQualification: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) with valid Council of Architecture registration
jobs.preferredQualification: Master of Architecture (M.Arch.), BIM / Sustainable Design / Project Management Certification
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for leading the complete architectural function across all UrbanGaon developments by driving concept design, design development, consultant coordination, statutory approvals, value engineering, execution support and design governance while ensuring quality, compliance, cost optimization and timely project delivery.
responsibilities: Lead concept planning through construction support.
Ensure architectural excellence across all projects.
Coordinate Structural, MEP, Landscape and Interior consultants.
Review and approve drawings before release.
Drive statutory approvals.
Implement value engineering.
Support execution teams through site reviews.
Standardize design documentation and QA.
Present designs to leadership.
Develop and mentor the architecture team.
Monitor industry trends and sustainable practices.
competencies: Expertise in architectural planning and execution.
Knowledge of NBC, local bye-laws and approvals.
Leadership and consultant management.
Value engineering and constructability review.
AutoCAD, Revit, BIM and presentation skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Ownership, integrity and continuous improvement mindset.

jobs.title: In-house Research Analyst
jobs.reportsTo: Head of AI Adoption, IT & Research
jobs.mandatoryQualification: Graduate in Computer Science / IT / AI / Data Science / Engineering (or related technical discipline) — mandatory
jobs.preferredQualification: MCA / M.Tech in AI, Data Science, IT, or Business Analytics — preferred, not mandatory
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for driving in-house research intelligence covering market, competitor, and technology trends to support strategic decision-making across UrbanGaon, delivering timely and actionable insights to leadership and cross-functional teams.
responsibilities: Conduct market research on real estate trends, pricing, and demand patterns.
Track competitor projects, launches, pricing, and positioning.
Track and evaluate emerging AI, IT, and technology tools/trends relevant to the business, and monitor industry and regulatory developments.
Build and maintain research databases and knowledge repositories, leveraging AI/IT tools to automate data collection and analysis.
Prepare research reports, dashboards, and presentations for leadership.
Support due diligence for new projects, land acquisitions, and market-entry decisions.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, and strategy teams to translate research into actionable insights.
Conduct primary research (surveys, site visits, customer interviews) as needed.
Benchmark organisational performance against industry standards and best practices.
Ensure research outputs are timely, accurate, and well-sourced.
competencies: Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
Ability to synthesise large volumes of information into clear, actionable insights.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and research/data tools; working knowledge of AI tools, data analytics platforms, and SQL/Python is a strong plus.
Good understanding of real estate market dynamics and interest in AI/IT adoption trends (preferred).
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple research requests within tight timelines.
Curiosity and a proactive approach to tracking industry and market trends.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.mandatoryQualification: B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Civil Engineering, with a strong execution background — mandatory
jobs.preferredQualification: Additional certification in project management (e.g., PMP) — an added advantage
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for owning end-to-end project execution across UrbanGaon developments — including scheduling, contractor management, site coordination, quality and safety compliance, cost tracking, billing coordination, and project reporting — to ensure timely and quality delivery of project milestones.
responsibilities: Own overall project execution and ensure delivery as per the approved schedule.
Prepare, monitor, and update project schedules and milestones.
Coordinate and manage contractors, sub-contractors, and site teams.
Ensure quality standards are maintained across all stages of construction.
Implement and monitor site safety protocols and compliance.
Track project costs and monitor budget adherence.
Coordinate billing and certification of contractor and vendor payments.
Prepare and present regular project progress reports to leadership.
Resolve on-site execution issues and coordinate with design and consultant teams.
Ensure timely procurement and availability of materials for site progress.
Drive milestone delivery and proactively flag delays or risks.
competencies: Strong technical knowledge of building construction and execution practices.
Proven ability to plan, schedule, and monitor large projects.
Strong contractor and vendor management skills.
Sound understanding of quality and safety standards on site.
Cost-conscious with strong budget tracking discipline.
Clear, structured reporting and communication skills.
Ownership-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented under pressure.

jobs.title: Purchase Officer – International Procurement (China Exposure)
jobs.preferredQualification: Supply Chain / Commerce / Engineering background — an added advantage
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for sourcing materials from China and international suppliers — including preparing RFQs, comparing landed costs, negotiating terms, coordinating samples, verifying vendors, managing import documentation and logistics, and monitoring quality and supplier performance — to ensure timely, cost-effective, and quality procurement.
responsibilities: Source materials and equipment from Chinese and other international suppliers.
Prepare and issue RFQs (Request for Quotations) to prospective vendors.
Compare landed costs across suppliers, including freight, duties, and taxes.
Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers.
Coordinate sample requests, approvals, and quality benchmarking.
Conduct vendor verification and due diligence before onboarding.
Prepare and manage import documents such as invoices, packing lists, and certificates of origin.
Coordinate logistics, shipping, and customs clearance with freight forwarders.
Monitor quality control (QC) at source and upon receipt of goods.
Track and evaluate supplier performance on cost, quality, and delivery.
Maintain accurate purchase records and support cost-saving initiatives.
competencies: Strong negotiation skills with international vendors.
Proficiency in Excel for cost comparison and analysis.
Sound knowledge of import documentation and customs procedures.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to evaluate quality and conduct vendor due diligence.
Detail-oriented with strong follow-up and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple suppliers and shipments simultaneously.

jobs.title: Supervisor (Civil)
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for supervising daily site activity — including labor and vendor coordination, drawing execution, material tracking, quality checks, safety discipline, and daily progress reporting — and escalating site issues promptly to ensure smooth on-site execution.
responsibilities: Supervise daily site activities and ensure work progresses as per plan.
Coordinate labor and vendor teams for efficient site execution.
Execute work as per approved drawings and specifications.
Track material consumption, wastage, and stock at site.
Conduct quality checks at each stage of construction.
Enforce safety discipline and ensure use of PPE on site.
Prepare and submit daily progress reports to the Project Manager.
Escalate site issues, delays, or discrepancies promptly.
Coordinate with contractors and sub-contractors on daily work allocation.
Ensure housekeeping and site cleanliness standards are maintained.
Support inspection and audit activities as required.
competencies: Practical, hands-on knowledge of civil construction workflow.
Strong labor and manpower handling skills.
Ability to read and execute technical drawings accurately.
Sound understanding of site safety practices and discipline.
Attention to detail in material tracking and quality checks.
Ability to identify and escalate site issues promptly.
Strong ownership and hands-on execution mindset.

jobs.title: Accounts Manager (Head)
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for leading the accounts function across UrbanGaon construction projects by ensuring accurate bookkeeping, timely statutory compliance, project-wise cost and vendor accounting, and reliable financial reporting, while maintaining strong internal controls and supporting management with MIS and audit readiness.
responsibilities: Lead and oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including books of accounts, ledgers, and bank and cash management.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounts in Tally, with regular review and reconciliation.
Manage project-wise accounting, including cost tracking, budget-vs-actual analysis, and work-in-progress (WIP) accounting.
Process and verify contractor and vendor bills, running bills, retention, advances, and payments.
Ensure timely GST, TDS, TCS, PF/ESI and other statutory filings, including RERA-related accounting requirements.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports for management.
Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and banks for statutory audits, assessments, and financial queries.
Monitor cash flow and fund requirements across projects, and maintain strong internal controls and accounting policies.
Supervise, guide, and train the accounts team to ensure accuracy and timely closures.
competencies: Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP / Prime) and accounting software.
Good hands-on knowledge of accounting laws, GST, TDS, Income Tax, and Companies Act provisions.
Experience in construction or real estate accounting, including project and contractor accounting.
Strong analytical, reconciliation, and MIS-preparation skills.
Leadership ability to guide a team and coordinate with auditors and consultants.
Good communication skills and a strong sense of ownership and integrity.

jobs.title: Deputy Project Manager
jobs.mandatoryQualification: B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Civil Engineering, with a solid site execution background — mandatory
jobs.preferredQualification: PMP or similar project management certification; MS Project / Primavera — an added advantage
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for supporting the Project Manager in project execution across UrbanGaon developments — including site management, scheduling, contractor coordination, quality and safety compliance, cost monitoring, billing support, and reporting — and leading the project in the Project Manager's absence.
responsibilities: Support the Project Manager in overall project execution and drive day-to-day site progress as per the approved schedule.
Assist in preparing, monitoring, and updating project schedules, look-ahead plans, and milestones.
Coordinate with contractors, sub-contractors, and site teams; supervise daily work allocation.
Conduct regular site inspections to ensure quality standards are maintained across all stages of construction.
Implement and monitor site safety protocols, and ensure compliance through regular checks and toolbox talks.
Track quantities, project costs, and budget adherence, and escalate variances to the Project Manager.
Verify measurements and support billing and certification of contractor and vendor payments.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports for the Project Manager and leadership.
Resolve on-site issues and coordinate with design and consultant teams on drawings and approvals.
Follow up on procurement and ensure timely availability of materials for site progress.
Proactively flag delays or risks to the Project Manager, and lead the project in the Project Manager's absence.
competencies: Sound technical knowledge of building construction and execution practices.
Ability to plan, schedule, and monitor project activities using scheduling tools.
Good contractor and vendor coordination skills.
Sound understanding of quality and safety standards on site.
Cost-conscious with good budget tracking discipline.
Clear, structured reporting and communication skills.
Ownership-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented, ready to step into a leadership role.

jobs.title: Purchase Manager – Construction Procurement
jobs.preferredQualification: B.E. / B.Tech (Civil) or MBA in Supply Chain / Materials Management — an added advantage
jobs.rolePurpose: Responsible for planning and managing the procurement of construction materials, equipment, and subcontract packages across projects — including preparing RFQs and tender comparisons, negotiating rates and terms, developing and evaluating vendors and subcontractors, coordinating site deliveries, and ensuring material quality and compliance — to deliver timely, cost-effective, and quality procurement within project budgets and schedules.
responsibilities: Plan and manage procurement of construction materials (cement, steel, aggregates, electrical, finishing) and equipment as per project schedules.
Prepare and issue RFQs and tender documents; conduct technical and commercial bid comparisons.
Negotiate rates, payment terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers and subcontractors; finalize rate contracts.
Prepare and issue purchase orders and work orders in line with BOQ and approved budgets.
Develop, empanel, and verify vendors and subcontractors through due diligence and site visits.
Coordinate with project and site teams to track material requirements and ensure timely delivery to site.
Ensure material quality as per specifications and approved samples; resolve rejections with vendors.
Verify vendor invoices and GRNs, ensure GST compliance, and maintain purchase records and MIS reports.
competencies: Strong negotiation and commercial acumen with suppliers and subcontractors.
Sound knowledge of construction materials, specifications, and market rates.
Ability to read BOQs, drawings, and technical specifications.
Proficiency in Excel and ERP / procurement software for cost comparison and MIS.
Knowledge of contracts, GST, and statutory compliance in construction.
Strong English and Hindi communication, with good follow-up and coordination skills.
